questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the true value of a liberal arts education.
options: I hadn't finished my degree when I realized the true value of a liberal arts education.

questions.question: The company would have been in financial trouble if not for the timely intervention of its investors.
options: If not for the timely intervention of its investors, the company was in financial trouble.
Had it not been for the timely intervention of its investors, the company would be in financial trouble now.
The company is in financial trouble because it did not have the timely intervention of its investors.
It's only because of the timely intervention of its investors that the company was not in financial trouble.
questions.answer: Had it not been for the timely intervention of its investors, the company would be in financial trouble now.

questions.question: By the time she arrived at the party, most of the guests had already left.
options: Most of the guests had already left by the time she arrived at the party.

It was only when she arrived at the party that it became clear that most of the guests had already left.
The guests were still arriving as she arrived at the party.
questions.answer: Most of the guests had already left by the time she arrived at the party.

questions.question: It is essential that the new policy be implemented immediately, or else the company will suffer significant losses.
options: Unless the new policy is implemented immediately, the company will suffer significant losses.
The new policy must be implemented immediately, otherwise the company will suffer significant losses.

questions.question: What I said was not that I didn't want to go, but rather that I wasn't sure if I could afford it.
options: It was not what I said that mattered, but rather why I said it.
I said that I couldn't afford to go, and that's all there is to it.
What I actually meant to say was that I didn't want to go at all.
It wasn't that I didn't want to go; what I said was that I wasn't sure if I could afford it.
questions.answer: It wasn't that I didn't want to go; what I said was that I wasn't sure if I could afford it.
